limitations: All actual images were inspected. Earlier screenshots are 193x413; the controlled three-picture on/off/restore comparison is consistently 488x1057 while logical Canvas remains 390.4x844. Only that matched set supports its pixel comparison.
Partial-alpha ray samples are guides, not proof of a wholly covered footprint. The actual source reports the overview panorama, not the detail mask.
Moon coverage-v2 is local integrated development evidence, not delivered to phone. Old D phone evidence is not upgraded.
No production source changes were made for these observations; independent review and full Stellarium experience/quality remain open.
